features.name: shared persistent world
features.notes: one common world with no personal plots
features.quote: No personal plot at all — one common world everybody operates in together.

features.name: central spawn hub
features.quote: Spawn Hub - central area where the player begins.

features.name: NPC vendor stalls
features.quote: Contains the roll station platform, NPC vendors

features.name: upgrades bazaar storefronts
features.notes: central storefront zone with eggs upgrades and progression shops
features.quote: Upgrades Bazaar: The central storefront zone — eggs, upgrades, progression shops

features.name: crafting workbench building
features.notes: building or room containing workbench NPC
features.quote: Crafting area - a building/room containing the crafting workbench NPC.

features.name: connected biome zones
features.notes: distinct environments connected to the central world
features.quote: The world is a single explorable place composed of connected zones.

features.name: walkable connecting paths
features.quote: Explorable paths - walkable terrain connecting zones

features.name: higher tier zone entrances
features.quote: Purchase Gate: Physical walls blocking higher-tier zones

features.name: hub to zone circulation
features.notes: continuous walkable or drivable route from hub to value areas
features.quote: Walkable or drivable circulation chaining the hub to wherever value is actually produced.

features.name: biome weather effects
features.quote: Each has its own skybox, lighting, terrain, ambient audio, and particle weather.

features.name: aura particle effects
features.notes: glowing particles beams or trails around visible avatars
features.quote: The equipped aura renders as attached ParticleEmitters / Beams / Trails and dynamic lighting on the character

excluded.name: UI overlays
excluded.why: screen interface rather than world layout
